name.zh: 检索防御

lead.en: Whether common retrieval defences have been used in an action flow, and whether the consequences of actions were measured.
lead.zh: 常用检索防御是否用于行动流程，是否测过动作后果。

rows: No (question answering only in RAG Security Bench)
Partly: persistent agent memory, but measures answers or verdicts
Agent setting tests attacks only (AgentPoison, ReAct-StrategyQA)

q.en: Have retrieval defences been tried in action flows?
q.zh: 检索防御用于行动流程了吗？

a.en: None of the 6 defences fully: SMSR covers persistent agent memory in part but measures answers or verdicts.
a.zh: 6 个防御中没有一个完整用于行动流程：SMSR 部分涉及持久记忆，但测的是答案或判定。

q.en: Were consequences of actions measured?

a.en: In none of the 8 rows; Oracle Poisoning uses real SDK tool calls but measures the acceptance of forged conclusions.
a.zh: 8 行都没有；Oracle Poisoning 使用真实 SDK 工具调用，但测的是是否接受伪造结论。

name.zh: 检索到记录实验

lead.en: 90 questions × clean, poisoned and poisoned-with-instruction retrieval × no defence, TrustRAG and filter only.
lead.zh: 90 道题 × 干净、投毒、投毒加指令三种检索 × 无防御、TrustRAG、仅过滤。

q.en: Does retrieval protection carry to the final record?
q.zh: 检索保护能延续到最终记录吗？

a.en: Yes: 73 of 90 final records endorse the attacker's answer without a defence, 4 with TrustRAG (−76.7 points, 95% interval −85.6 to −67.8).
a.zh: 能：无防御时 90 条最终记录中 73 条认可攻击者答案，TrustRAG 下为 4 条（−76.7 个百分点，95% 区间 −85.6 至 −67.8）。

q.en: What does the filter alone do?

a.en: Also 4 of 90; two of the four questions are shared with TrustRAG.
a.zh: 同样 4/90；四道题中有两道与 TrustRAG 相同。

q.en: What does the protection cost?

a.en: Clean tasks that needed a recovery prompt: 15 of 90 without a defence, 38 with TrustRAG.
a.zh: 需要补救提示的干净任务：无防御 15/90，TrustRAG 38/90。

bg.zh: 下方：完成情况与补救提示

q.en: Was the authorisation boundary tested?

a.en: Not yet: 0 / 810 runs had an unauthorised execution in any setting.
a.zh: 还没有：任何设置下 0 / 810 次运行出现越权执行。

bg.zh: 数据与说明：全部 810 条记录

p.en: Setting: 90 PoisonedRAG NQ questions not used in development; one local model (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) and the same knowledge-tool interface in every setting; no defence, the full TrustRAG pipeline, and its k-means filter alone; measured at the tool answer and at the final record of the same flow. Labels are semantic judgements, model-assisted and adjudicated; uncertain labels stay apart and give a range, not a confidence interval. On the 81 questions whose target answer is invalid the result is 64/81 against 2/81. TrustRAG and the filter alone reach the same count but share only two of the four questions.
p.zh: 设置：90 道未参与开发的 PoisonedRAG NQ 题；所有设置用同一个本地模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）和同一个知识工具接口；无防御、完整 TrustRAG、只用其 k-means 过滤；在同一流程的工具回答和最终记录两处测量。标签为语义判定，模型辅助并经裁定；含糊标签单列，给出范围，不是置信区间。在目标答案无效的 81 题上，结果为 64/81 对 2/81。TrustRAG 与仅过滤计数相同，但四题中只有两题共同。
